title: CORE-LLM-Bench: A Controlled Neurosymbolic Benchmark for Ontology-Grounded Reasoning in Large Language Models
description: CORE-LLM-Bench v1.1.0 is a controlled neurosymbolic benchmark containing 9,048 question-hop instances across FamilyOWL, Pizza100, Pizza250, and OWL2Bench: 6,032 binary question-answering instances in 3,016 TRUE/FALSE pairs and 3,016 open-ended question-answering instances. Each instance aligns natural-language, formal-symbolic, and abstract-representation conditions and includes finalized answer-level explanations, complete tied-minimum explanation sets, primitive reasoning tags, complexity metadata, and source provenance. The release also contains the corrected offline evaluation of 81,432 frozen accepted model observations and a reasoning-tag difficulty analysis. No model response was regenerated or modified. Three AR prompts, task IDs 1274, 4094, and 5165, are confirmed defective; the primary analysis retains them and provides a separately identified exclusion sensitivity.
